BiblicalUsage: tsâʻîyph is the ordinary word for a veil. It appears 3 times in Scripture, including Genesis 24:65 and Genesis 38:14.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâʻîyph is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
